title: LectureCreate
description: Request body of POST /lectures. The API assigns id, status, created_at and updated_at. Omitted optional fields take the defaults stated below.

ends_at.description: End, ISO 8601 UTC, strictly after starts_at, at most 6 hours after it.

lighting_mode.description: Lighting mode applied at start, default lecture.

notes.description: Free text, at most 500 characters, default null.

examples.title: Distributed Systems, week 7
